text:
maya: Quick sync — we need to lock GA acceptance for Private Deploy v2 today. Key open buckets: SLA windows, monitoring/data retention, pricing tiers, and support escalation matrix.
ashok: +1. Can we scope SLA to P99 latency + uptime? what window for SLO burn alerts?
maya: Proposal: P99 latency 200ms for <1k rps config, 500ms for burst mode. Uptime 99.95%. Alerting: page at 5m sustained SLO burn.
jess: That seems reasonable. How do we measure P99 across pinned vs fallback models?
carlos: Runtime will emit per-model latency histograms. We should specify histogram buckets and labels. Also need clear fallback tagging so metrics are attributable.
sam: Ops question — retention for traces/logs? Support needs at least 30d for tracing, 90d for access logs for audits.
liz: Docs callout: we need exact error taxonomy + example incidents for runbook. If paging rules change, docs must reflect thresholds and contact lists.
maya: Okay — mandatory: 30d traces, 90d access logs. Add a compliance flag for customers that need longer retention (paid addon).
ashok: For SLA credits, finance wants a simple formula. Suggest: credit = monthly fee * min(1, (SLA_target - observed)/SLA_target * 10%). Need legal signoff.
jess: Can we avoid percent-of-fee complexity at GA? Maybe a cap like single-month credit up to 10%? keeps sales simpler.
carlos: Scalability: GA must include autoscale test plan. We need a runbook for graceful degradation (route to cheaper model variant) and a traffic-shed policy.
sam: Escalation matrix draft: P0 (data loss/major outage) page to oncall + eng lead + product director. P1 (degraded performance) page to oncall + eng-sre. P2 email to support.
ops-bot: reminder: canary rollout policy enforced via console. default rollout 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 2h observation windows.
liz: Docs will produce: "GA checklist" page, SLA explainer, runbooks (P0/P1/P2), pricing FAQ. Need owners + due dates.
maya: Owners: eng (ashok) autoscale/runbook due EOD+3, eng-sre (sam) SLO/alerting config due EOD+2, docs (liz) draft due EOD+4, finance (jess) finalize credit policy EOD+2.
ashok: Technical acceptance criteria (short):
```
- Pass autoscale soak: 2h at target rps with 0.5% errors
- Latency within P99 targets over 24h in staging
- Fallbacks exercised with traced attribution
- KV/prefix cache warmup verified
```
jess: Support readiness checklist: playbook for customer handoff, dedicated support tiers doc, 24/7 escalation contacts for Enterprise.
carlos: Monitoring acceptance: dashboards for latency, error-rate, QPS by model+region, and a synthetic probe per region. Alert noise thresholding required (no noisy flaps).
maya: Pricing: two GA tiers — Standard (shared infra) and Dedicated (reserved capacity). We need a SKU for retention addon and premium support. Keep initial discounts for early customers.
sam: Oncall staffing: Enterprise GA requires named 24/7 rotation for first 30 days. Sales to inform which customers are on early GA so we can allocate.
liz: I'll template the runbook examples and a short "what to expect at GA" customer email draft.
maya: Decision points before EOD: Approve SLA numbers (P99/uptime), retention defaults, credit cap, oncall staffing commitment. If any objections, call now.
jess: Support + finance align on credit cap 10% and simple formula.
ashok: Engineering ok with P99 numbers, will validate in staging load test.
carlos: Agree with autoscale tests. I'll kick off a stress run at 16:00 UTC.
sam: I'll update pager rules and create escalation playbook.
liz: Docs will publish draft PR and ping channel when ready.
maya: Great — action items captured. If we hit blockers, we'll escalate to execs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy-checklist: canary policy configured, synthetic probes scheduled.
